speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe the severity and location of your flank pain, and have you noticed any changes in your urine, such as blood or cloudiness?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any pain or burning sensation when you urinate, and have you noticed any visible blood or cloudiness in your urine? Additionally, are you experiencing any nausea or vomiting along with these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you experience any joint pain, swelling, or abdominal discomfort while taking the cephalexin? Also, have you noticed any changes in your urine output, such as foamy urine or decreased volume?

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your recent rash and subsequent symptoms, I suspect interstitial nephritis. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Serum Creatinine, White Blood Cell Count
